summary: Applied the existing exact criterion to finite moral prohibition assignments and three explicitly restricted controls. Rejected treating the thin opposite-truth pair as metaphysically admissible under every rival, and rejected formalizing Enoch’s modest third-factor correlation as an exceptionless classifier. Reread materialized q94 aa2/4, Railton193–195, Boyd§§4.4–4.5 and Enoch§§5.1–5.3: natural-law particular judgment and naturalist inquiry remain fallible; Enoch’s qualified pro-tanto survival bridge does not yield categorical innocent-killing prohibition. Analyst controls expose constitutive/sufficient/categorical assumptions without attributing those exact Boolean conditions to authors. Source locators, interpretation boundaries, strongest replies and remaining specific normative/access obligations persist in docs/naturalistic-moral-realism.md, Identical-evidence test. No root premise discharged.
